news.headline: Multi-Year Engine Exchange Program Extends from V2500, Replacing Traditional Shop Visits with Serviceable Engines Delivered Ahead of Scheduled Removals
news.summary: FTAI extended its engine exchange program to the CFM56-7B after launching it on the V2500. Customers receive serviceable engines ahead of scheduled removals instead of going through traditional shop visits.

news.headline: FTAI Aviation acquires 27 Boeing 737-700 aircraft from WestJet
news.summary: FTAI's 2026 SPV bought 17 WestJet-leased aircraft via sale-leaseback, and FTAI acquired the other 10 off lease for its Aerospace Products business.

news.headline: FTAI strengthens collaboration with Garuda Indonesia's GMF on engine maintenance in Asia-Pacific
news.summary: The expanded partnership with GMF broadens FTAI's engine maintenance reach in Asia-Pacific.

news.headline: FTAI Aviation board authorizes share repurchase program of up to $500 million
news.summary: The board approved a buyback of up to $500 million.

news.headline: FTAI closes $2.0 billion warehouse facility for 2026 SPV
news.summary: The facility carries a $1.0 billion accordion that could lift total capacity to $3.0 billion, funding aircraft acquisitions.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: Results before market open with an 8:00 a.m. ET call.

pulse: FTAI is expanding its engine exchange model (V2500, now CFM56-7B) and scaling aircraft acquisitions via a $2B warehouse facility, while a new $500M buyback and a $0.50 quarterly dividend support capital returns. Q3 results on Oct 29 are the next key test.
